

``` {r quiz2}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(fpp3)
library(here)
library(readxl)
library(slider)
```

```{r quiz2 pt2}
aus_labor <- read_excel(here("Module 2/data/fred-aus-labor-force.xlsx"), 
                        sheet = "Monthly", 
                        col_types = c("date", "numeric"),
                        col_names = c('Date', 'Persons'), skip = 1) |> 
    mutate(Month = yearmonth(Date)) |> 
    select(-Date) |>
    as_tsibble(index = Month)

aus_labor |> autoplot(Persons) + labs(title = "Australian Labor Force", y = "Persons (millions)")
```

```{r quiz2 pt3}
#| fig-height: 2.2
#| fig-width: 6
MAs <- aus_labor |> filter(year(Month) >= 2022) |>
    mutate(
        `13-MA` = slide_dbl(Persons, mean, .before = 1, .after = 1, .complete = FALSE),
        `12-MA` = slide_dbl(Persons, mean, .before = 5, .after = 6, .complete = TRUE),
        `2x12-MA` = slide_dbl(`12-MA`, mean, .before = 1, .after = 0, .complete = TRUE)
        )

residuals <- MAs |>
    mutate(
        res_13MA = `13-MA` - Persons,
        res_12MA = `12-MA` - Persons,
        res_2x12MA = `2x12-MA` - Persons
    )
residuals |> autoplot(res_13MA) + geom_hline(yintercept = mean(residuals$res_13MA, na.rm = TRUE), linetype = "dashed")
```

```{r quiz2 pt4}

aus_labor_fit <- aus_labor |>
    filter(Month < max(Month) - 12) |>
    model(lm1 = TSLM(Persons ~ trend()),
          lm2 = TSLM(Persons ~ trend() + season()),
          ets_hs = ETS(Persons),
          ets_auto = ETS(Persons ~ trend('A') + season('A')))
aus_labor_fit |> report()
```
